Covers Scotland south of Dornoch Firth and east of Isle of Skye. Hand colored in red, green, and blue to show selected travel toutes. Relief shown by hachures. Not signed by Millard Fillmore, but originally accompanied map no. 58a of Scotland (cover signed by Fillmore). Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
